title: RFC 4777 — IBM's iSeries Telnet Enhancements (TN5250E)
summary: Current published TN5250E enhancement reference. It obsoletes RFC 2877 and adds/corrects enhanced negotiation, device-name handling, auto-signon/password mechanisms, Kerberos/SHA-1 material, printer pass-through, security and IANA considerations while relying on RFC 1205.
navigation: Early sections: standard and enhanced Telnet negotiation.
Display sections: enhanced display/device-name support and auto-signon.
Printer sections: steady-state pass-through and examples.
Security Considerations: treat as required reading before implementing credentials or auto-signon.
Section 17: relationship to RFC 1205 and replacement of RFC 2877.
invariants: RFC 4777 relies on RFC 1205 rather than replacing the base 5250 Telnet interface.
